review_evidence: README describes basic HTTP functionality built on Socket.lean, including command-line GET and an executable Client.get example.
A complete scan of nine Lean files found 90 declaration-style items and no theorem/lemma/axiom/example declarations.

The source defines URI/header/request/response data types, parsers, serialization and socket client operations; it does not state a formal HTTP/URI semantics, parser-correctness theorem, protocol conformance property, or reusable proof development.

source_action.content_invariant: The nine Lean files implement a conventional HTTP/URI client and parser API and contain no proposition declarations or independent formal protocol semantics. Removing this source therefore does not hide unique mathematical statements, proofs, specifications, or formal-semantics prior art.
